vin_damper.load: 72 W constant power at 17.2 V (upper estimate, linearised)

R92_stress.note: 1.5 V VIN dip assumed for the step energy; 1206 250 mW part

S83_rule_full_12V_in_blanking.note: S8.3 screen: whole 12 V inside the 18 ms blanking at 20 V, 1 A; superseded by the datasheet hiccup rule

-12V.allowance_basis: min(hiccup model, TI output-capacitance guidance minus the rated onboard bank)
-12V.ti_limit: <= ~10 x design COUT or 1000 uF, whichever is smaller (SNVSC40E 9.2.2.5)

soft_start.rack_reference: Typical Eurorack module: 10-47 uF per rail; 20 modules x 22 uF = 0.44 mF per rail. +/-12V rely on converter soft start. S8.4: -12V allowance per the LMR38020 hiccup rule, see minus12_startup
soft_start.note: track_ramp_max_C / max_C are TOTAL capacitance (onboard + rack); rack_allowance subtracts the onboard bank at its high corner. Loads that draw less than the full target during start-up leave more room (no_load column). Bench item: -12V start-up into the real rack.

response_us.total_after_crossing: ~3 us + RC; then U5 off, rails decay

ov_guard.note: The bands are threshold screens, not a peak-voltage guarantee: opening U5 does not stop the energy already stored behind it. A false trip latches every rail off (MAIN off, press RESET). Common-mode: both comparator inputs sit at ~1.24 V at a positive trip, inside VPD-2 V at full temperature; -12V compares near 0 V.

ov_reference.earliest_rail_rise_ms: > 12 (TPS3808 open-CT POR minimum) + U5 ramp + converter soft start
ov_reference.stability: TLV431 is stable without a capacitor; 10u X5R (~9 uF at 1.24 V) is right of the oscillation region (~3 nF..1 uF at VKA = VREF, SLVS139Z Fig. 5-18; Fig. 5-19 phase margin ~25-40 deg at 0.4-1.5 mA)

S8_without_clamp.note: S8: R98 7.5k to V3V3, R99 47k to -12V, no clamp

ov_clamp.note: BAT54SL VF <= 0.24 V at 0.1 mA is a 25 C limit only: U20 pin 9 stays above -0.3 V at room temperature; cold (VF ~+2 mV/C) or at -16 V it can go below -0.3 V (not a guaranteed clamp). Since S8.3 U20 runs from VPD, so it MAY be powered in this state (S8.4 review M3, see v3v3_loss): the protection argument is that R99 limits the node current to <= 0.15 mA (LM2901B abs max -50 mA into an input) and that an incorrect U20 output cannot enable anything while V3V3 is gone (R64 holds RUN low). In normal operation the diode is reverse biased by 0.14 V and by ~0 V at the trip point, so its leakage does not move the threshold.

comparator_supply.supply: VPD before U5, after F1; D1 transient clamp
comparator_supply.note: Positive headroom during qualified operation. D1 rated clamp is NOT a measured ringing bound. Verify VPD spikes <36V at both comparator ICs; V3V3-loss states are in v3v3_loss; cold negative-input clamp and replug remain bench gates.

states.U20 powered (VPD up, V3V3 lost or not ye: positive channels: REF_OV ~0 V, taps >= 0 V, output state undefined/low; -12V channel: MON_OVN negative if the rack holds -12V, D22 clamps
states.U20 unpowered (VPD gone): inputs see the same divider; only the bounded input current matters
states.logic: U10-U15 unpowered, all pull-ups (R97 OV_N, R35/R62 status, R63 MAIN_OK) go to the dead V3V3; R64 holds RUN low -> U5 SHDN low, U2 EN (MAIN_OK) low, U4 follows +12V: nothing can be enabled by any comparator output

v3v3_loss.LM2901B_input_abs_max: -0.3 V; input current -50 mA max (SLCS006Z 6.1); footnote: current through the parasitic input diode can make the output incorrect, normal operation resumes after
v3v3_loss.common_mode: inputs 0..VPD-2 V while VPD >= 15 V except MON_OVN (-0.24 V at 25 C, ~-0.37 V cold screen)
v3v3_loss.D1: SMBJ22A on VPD does not conduct in these states (stand-off 22 V); its 35.5 V rated clamp leaves 0.5 V to the LM2901B 36 V recommended maximum (38 V abs max): VPD ringing at U18/U20 is a bench gate
v3v3_loss.replug: see replug_por (S8.5): the S8.4 ~1 ms replug margin ignored the R98 load on REF_OV and is withdrawn
v3v3_loss.verdict: No enable path exists while V3V3 is gone; the input current is bounded far below the abs-max. The D22 clamp is NOT a guaranteed -0.3 V clamp when cold. Replug into a rack holding -12V: OPEN item (replug_por), not a margin.

minus12_startup.rule: hiccup only if |Vout| < 40 % (4.80 V) with ILS limiting for 256 cycles after TOCP_BLK
minus12_startup.vin_floor_basis: converter VIN at the U5 turn-on minimum (VPD 16.23 V) minus the 1.00 V D10 + U5 drop: the converters cannot start below it
minus12_startup.vin_sag_basis: converter VIN at the U5 turn-off minimum (VPD 15.04 V): a source sagging during start-up can hold the converters this low

input_path.basis: R2 senses VPD before D10; converter VIN = VPD - D10 (0.75 V S5 screen at 5 A) - U5 RON max (53 mOhm, S5) x its 4.698 A high-corner current limit (input_budget U5_limit_screen_A): no steady input current can exceed the actual U5 limit, so this is a conservative drop, not a typical one

minus12_startup.hiccup_model_basis: VIN15.23_I1A_blank9ms: converter VIN at the U5 turn-on minimum, 1 A from 0 V, half the typical-only 18 ms blanking (TI gives no minimum)

TI_COUT_guidance.text: limit total output capacitance to ~10 x the design value or 1000 uF, whichever is smaller (SNVSC40E 9.2.2.5); beyond it start-up at full load and loop stability need a dedicated study

minus12_startup.published_basis: min(hiccup model, TI output-capacitance guidance minus the rated onboard bank)
minus12_startup.window_check: time to full 12 V at the allowance stays far below the 309 ms startup-window minimum
minus12_startup.note: Analytic screen, not a guarantee: TOCP_BLK has no specified minimum and the hiccup restart behaviour is not specified. The rack capacitance sits behind cables, but TI's total-COUT guidance is applied anyway. Bench gate: start into the real rack at the lowest input.

rating.rule: 75 % of the minimum current-limited capability at the 17.25 V converter input (rated source range VPD >= 18.25 V minus the 1.00 V D10 + U5 drop), to the NEAREST 0.1 A, capped at the S7 target

input_path.basis: R2 senses VPD before D10; converter VIN = VPD - D10 (0.75 V S5 screen at 5 A) - U5 RON max (53 mOhm, S5) x its 4.698 A high-corner current limit (input_budget U5_limit_screen_A): no steady input current can exceed the actual U5 limit, so this is a conservative drop, not a typical one

below_rated_range.basis: U5 keeps the converters running down to its turn-off minimum (sagging source); the rating is NOT specified there

rating.headers: above ~2 A per rail use both J2 and J3 (2 contacts per rail per header, ~1 A IDC contact screen)
rating.note: Prototype rating from datasheet minimum limits and assumed efficiencies, not a measured or thermal-qualified rating.

basic_only_counterfactual.note: Every precision divider at 1 % + 1 % TCR (Basic). Any failing entry is a screen the design no longer passes; hence the documented Extended exception (sourcing.json basic_only_policy).

startup_window.arming: S8.5: one-shot, see arming (TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED; S8.4 RUN AND MAIN_OK was restartable)

required: R1 bounded: ARMED within the U11 delay (0.31-0.88 s) of the first converter enable after RESET, and held until RESET/FAULT: the converters can never run unarmed for longer
R2 no restart: nothing a fault can toggle (MAIN_OK, PGOOD, VPD, V20_OK, the rails) restarts or extends the window; only RESET (or a power-on reset) does

R3 no early arming: the window starts only at a genuine converter enable, i.e. U5 on through its own UVLO with valid status; the PD 5 V phase or an intermediate PDO cannot start it, so no threshold below the converter enable point can arm
R4 fail-safe: after ARMED any bad status > ~1 ms latches FAULT; FAULT holds RUN low until RESET; OV_N (U20 guard) presets FAULT at any time

topology.STARTED: U12 flip-flop A used as a set/reset latch: PRE_N = START_N, CLR_N = RESET_N, CLK = GND (no clock edges), D = V3V3, Q = STARTED (TP19)
topology.START_N: U14 gate 2 (spare in S8.4): NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, RUN, V3V3, V3V3); low once U5 is on with PGOOD and FLT good, its status validated by V20_OK, while RUN. Level-sensitive, so a MAIN_OK that is already high at RESET release (PGOOD deglitch) still starts it; RUN in the gate keeps PRE_N high while RESET clears the latch
topology.TIMER_GO: U13 gate 3 = RUN AND STARTED -> R69/R70 -> U11 SENSE (unchanged divider)
topology.ARMED: U11 RESET output (R71 pull-up) = ARMED directly; it stays high because its input is latched
topology.parts: no new IC: the spare U14 gate and U12 flip-flop A re-used, R83 200k -> 120k (Basic, same line as R75), TP19 (copper)

V20_OK.role: U5 status-validity floor: masks U5 FLT/PGOOD (MAIN_OK, R63 pull-up) where U5 is below its 4.5 V operating minimum (PD 5 V phase); NOT an input-good threshold
V20_OK.rule: band minimum >= vSafe5V max 5.5 V + 2.0 V and band maximum <= U5 turn-off minimum - 2.0 V
V20_OK.consequence: whenever U5 can be on (VPD >= its 15.04 V turn-off minimum) V20_OK is high, so MAIN_LED_OK = MAIN_OK there and V20_OK can never be the first status to drop; ANY_BAD = NOT(MAIN_LED_OK AND P12_OK AND N12_OK) means "U5 not on with valid status, or a rail below its monitor threshold"
V20_OK.S8.4_problem: S8.4 V20_OK 14.62-17.73 V tripped below the U5 turn-on band (16.23-18.23 V) and above its turn-off minimum, so it meant neither "input good" nor "status valid"; S8.3 (220k, up to ~19.4 V) could mask arming indefinitely. With TIMER_GO = RUN AND MAIN_OK a fault cycling U5 (overload auto-retry, sagging source) restarted the window forever, and MAIN_OK floating high in the PD 5 V phase armed the board before 20 V arrived

arming.input_qualification: U5 UVLO through MAIN_OK: on 16.23-18.23 V (unloaded source: 20 V -5 % = 19.0 V, 0.77 V margin), off 15.04-17.12 V (loaded minimum 18.25 V, 1.13 V margin). S8.4 compared the unloaded turn-on maximum with the loaded minimum (20 mV); that comparison was wrong

window.arming: S8.5: one-shot, see arming (TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED; S8.4 RUN AND MAIN_OK was restartable)

sequence: USB-C attach: VPD = vSafe5V; U9 makes V3V3; U10 holds RESET_N low >= 12 ms (clears STARTED, FAULT)
RESET_N high: RUN high (U5 SHDN released); U5 in UVLO, START_N high (V20_OK low in the 5 V phase)
PD contract: VPD -> 20 V; V20_OK high at 9.06-10.96 V (U5 status valid, PGOOD low)
VPD >= U5 turn-on (16.23-18.23 V): U5 ramps (~12 ms), PGOOD 11.5 ms typ -> MAIN_OK enables U2/U3 (U4 via Q1) -> MAIN_LED_OK -> START_N low -> STARTED (latched)
TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED -> U11 -> ARMED after 0.31-0.88 s; rails are up within ~66 ms
ARMED: any bad status (MAIN_LED_OK, P12_OK, N12_OK) > ~1 ms -> FAULT -> RUN low -> all off until RESET; OV_N presets FAULT at any time
arming.timelines: validation.json startup_arming.timelines (verify_s8 arming_timelines: cold start at the worst loaded 20 V minimum, slow PD contract, brown-out after/inside the window, input overload chatter, hot plug into a live bus, load release, U20 guard before ARMED, short RESET), checked against R1-R4 from the native gate wiring; the S8.4 wiring fails them (test_s8 regression)

replug_por.corners: worst: R100 +2 % (1 % + 1 % TCR), C67 +10 % tolerance x +15 % X5R temperature (12.65 uF), V3V3 -2 %, R98/R99 0.1 % corners, LM2901B 5.5 mV offset and 50 nA bias; V3V3 rise time ignored (it only helps: REF_OV starts charging before the POR delay starts)
replug_por.S84_screen: S8.4 v3v3_loss: 8.2-10.7 ms, ~1 ms margin; it charged C67 from V3V3 through R100 alone and ignored the R98 current into the D22-clamped MON_OVN node. Withdrawn
replug_por.consequence: OV_N low at RESET release presets FAULT: MAIN stays off until RESET is pressed (fail-safe nuisance latch, no damage). Only when the -12V bus is held by something else at power-up (second supply, or a quick replug while the rack capacitance still holds -12V).
replug_por.status: OPEN: the margin is not established; candidate fixes (not implemented in S8.5): C67 4.7 uF (still right of the TLV431 instability region) roughly halves the settle time, or a CT capacitor on U10 lengthens the POR delay (both also change the RESET timing).

input_budget.note: planning estimate; efficiencies are assumptions, not measurements

connectors.guidance: typical 2.54 mm IDC/ribbon contact ~1 A: use both headers above ~2 A per rail; unequal cable lengths/loads do not split equally

area.note: courtyard polygons from the pinned footprints, panel parts counted whole (they overhang the front edge by design). The placed P1 board record is docs/s8-single/board-p1.json
